liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Reviewer ranks this Shakedown among the best, alongside 6-30-85 and 6-22-91, with funky Jerry and strong Vince keyboards; Reviewer considers Shakedown and Cold Rain among the very best versions, and the Rain through Cold Rain run exceptional [17][19][20]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (2 reviews): Reviewer counts this Cold Rain among the best versions available; Reviewer calls the Cold Rain superb [17][20]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the set one Althea as nice [15]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Jerry strums a washboard-style sound during the China Cat into Rider [10]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): Reviewer calls this possibly the worst Eyes ever, with Garcia unable to find the melody or key [12]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer finds the half-hour Drums and Space stretch overindulgent and empty [12]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry plays Days Between superbly; it recalls the spooky, otherworldly version they saw at RFK in summer 1993 [11]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Throwing Stones after Days Between is nicely played, and the Not Fade Away encore was unexpected to the reviewer [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Electronic Percussion**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-16.schoeps.andrewf.131435.flac1644** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 164 min [1]
- **gd93-09-16.schoeps-byron-dnk.raras.8375.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this one of the best recorded and performed shows of the era, up through China Cat Sunflower; Audience recording has heft and low end, capturing full surround live feel; Jerry sounds clean and sharp [12][13]
- **gd1993-09-16.140487.sbd.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd93-09-16.sbd.herman.12370.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 162 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Opening night of the Madison Square Garden run, with high energy in the arena [10]
- Reviewer says such audience tapes would make pulled soundboards matter less; they like fall '93 shows despite flubs [13]
- Reviewer prefers the audience source to the Miller soundboard, though both sound good, as does the whole MSG run [15]
- Last Estimated>Eyes pairing was 2-26-95 with David Murray; reviewer rates 70s and 80s versions above 90s ones [16]
- Reviewer who attended Garden shows since '79 found this one forgettable, calling it a 2 at best after the opening songs [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-16.schoeps.andrewf.131435.flac1644**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: flac16 ; AUD: Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (ORTF) > unknown mic power and lead dat deck > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 > TDK DA-R DAT, set up end of floor center, directly… [1]
- **gd93-09-16.schoeps-byron-dnk.raras.8375.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Eliot Byron; transferred by Jim Raras; source: Audience: Schoeps mk21's [5]
- **gd1993-09-16.140487.sbd.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Set 1: SBD -> Dat -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> CDSet 2: SBD -> Dat (48k) [2]
- **gd93-09-16.sbd.herman.12370.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Steve Herman; source: Soundboard patched with Audience [3]
